description: The exact install command and code to add TraceTail browser fingerprinting (a stable visitor ID for each browser, without cookies) to a web app built with the given framework, with where each file goes. Works without an API key (keyless mode, no sign-up); pass the site's public API key to fill it in.

apiKey.description: The site's public TraceTail API key (tt_…), if it has one. Leave out to use the placeholder.

firstPartyPath.description: The path of the site's first-party proxy, e.g. /k3v9, to load TraceTail from the site's own domain.

framework.description: The app's framework: html (a plain script tag), javascript (any bundler), react, nextjs, vue, nuxt, angular or svelte.

name: get_integration_code
title: Get TraceTail integration code
